class.name: cite_test_hardware/JointStopSystem
class.description:
TEST FIXTURE, NOT A BACKEND (ADR-0040). mock_components/GenericSystem with a pair of hard stops on one named joint, so a trajectory can be made to mistrack part way along its path instead of at its first point, and with a velocity state that is the first difference of the position state rather than the permanent zero a position-only mock reports.
It refuses to initialise unless the description gives it a joint to stop and an interval to stop it in. Those parameters have no home in the L0 facility model, so no generated description can carry them.
